system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You learn to infuse some of your metallic chakra into your earth release jutsu, reinforcing their molecular structure, making them harder, stronger, and more durable.

When you cast a Jutsu with the Earth Release keyword that summons a creature, structure, or barrier with hit points, it becomes suffused with your metallic chakra, enhancing it further. Increase the hit points it has at creation, by an amount equal to your level or you can increase the DR it has at creation for the duration of its existence by an amount equal to your highest ability modifier.
